notes:
Lead source: inbound form from product page (support-automation). Small support platform for e-commerce SMBs. Interested primarily in self-serve hosted API to speed rollout.

Use / requirements (call notes):
- Workloads: automated ticket summarization + human-assist chat agent + outbound followup generation. Also want to use tool-calling to trigger updates in their ticketing system (webhook / REST).
- Output: structured JSON (title, summary, tags, priority) for direct ingestion into their ticket pipeline. Strong preference for stable schema and examples.
- Latency / throughput: target p95 < 500ms for single-turn summaries; anticipate 10-25 rps during normal peaks, spikes to ~60 rps Black Friday type windows. Cost sensitive - want clear per-token estimates for forecast.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated smaller models for cost savings; must be able to route heavier traffic to larger models for complex summarization.
- Deployment: public cloud only (GCP today). No VPC/On-prem for now.
- Security: SSO for portal (SAML) mandatory for internal admin; SOC2 report requested (they are SOC2-in-progress). Audit logging required for actions that mutate tickets.

Quotes & friction points:
- "We need the summary JSON to be reliable — mis-tags are worse than no tags." — Head of Support (Maria Lopez).
- CTO (Ethan Ramsey) wants a documented SAML flow and a simple SSO test account before procurement.

POC ask: 2-week self-serve eval using hosted API keys + 50k tokens of credit; sample webhook integration demo that shows tool-calling (create/update ticket). SE to provide example structured-output schema and a small script for batch-summarization.
